Docket 1.3.149

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $59, or $29.50 at the Black Friday price until 30 November, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A note is not a problem.* Findings marked "No action needed" were counted as problems: in each area's count,
  in "Docket found N more problems", in the report's "issues found" and on the area cards. Every count of problems
  now leaves them out. They are still in the report, under their own label.
- *An error page is not a refusal.* A site whose pages all answered with a server error, "not found" or something
  that is not a web page was told every page "refused Docket access". The verdict now says what came back, and the
  free version shows the problem that explains it instead of an unrelated one.
- *An area Docket could not read says so.* On a site whose pages carry no text until a script runs, unread areas
  said "not applicable", and the score had no note. They now say "not assessed", and the score says it is not a
  verdict on the site, in the app and on the command line.
- *The page limit you set is the number of pages you get.* A redirect used up two places in the page limit, so a
  limit of 15 could return 14 pages.
- *Another port is another site.* Auditing a site on one port could crawl pages from the same host on another
  port and report them as part of the site.
- *Core Web Vitals, as this run found them.* Reports said Core Web Vitals were not measured even when Google's real
  user data had been read. They now say which: read from Google, asked with no data for the site, or not asked.
- *Smaller fixes.* `docket logs` says how many paths a list left out. Two checks that shared the title "Internal
  linking" now have their own. An assistant using an unactivated copy is told that only activation keeps audits.

99 checks across 13 areas.
